column3: Deep cinematic ambient swell, thousands of faint glassy particles shimmering and slowly converging, dark and vast, no melody
Precise metallic key sliding into a heavy lock and turning with a soft mechanical click, close, dry
A small tablet falling into deep dark silence, faint airy whoosh then a soft distant impact, reverb tail
Warm low cinematic rise, soft string-like synth swelling like a sunrise, gentle and golden
Tense rising cinematic riser building upward, ending abruptly, no hit
Hollywood movie trailer title hit, deep sub boom with long cinematic reverb tail, then silence
Wide anamorphic lens flare whoosh sweeping left to right, airy and smooth
Slow underwater flowing current, muffled liquid movement, calm and deep
Thick warm liquid gushing into water, rich golden bubbling swell
Single soft cinematic reveal tone, warm piano-like bell with long tail
Small coins slowly sliding and trickling down a dark drain, distant, sparse
Long airy cinematic drone opening up into a wide landscape, hopeful but restrained
